caption: Palazzo d'Avalos above the beach, Vasto
composition: Elevated old town and palace on the cliff above the sandy Adriatic beach · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the beach the view rises to the old town crowning the cliff at the right, the palace's long stone front among the houses above the wooded slope, with the sandy Adriatic beach curving beneath at the lower left. The calm blue sea fills the left, and distant headlands close the horizon. At 14:41 the afternoon light is soft and golden, and the beach lies nearly empty.
